h1: The 5 Best Freestanding Murphy Beds of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Freestanding Murphy Beds: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: five Murphy bed cabinets compared on freestanding design, size, storage and anchoring, for renters and walls you cannot drill.
summary: The roomfitters Queen is the best overall, a stated freestanding cabinet bed with a large rattan underbed drawer. The roomfitters Full is the smaller version for solo sleepers, and the Peanu gray frame needs no wall bracket. The Peanu shelf cabinet leaves the freestanding claim unclear, and the LIVAUVEAD likely needs wall mounting.
intro: Freestanding gets stretched in Murphy bed listings. A bed that folds into a cabinet is not automatically free of the wall, and many models need a stud anchor to stay safe when the mattress swings down. If you rent, the anchoring method is the single detail to confirm before you order, because a cabinet that stands on its own base is the only kind that leaves the plaster alone.

Our editors reviewed five options from their listings and ranked them on whether freestanding is stated outright, then on size, storage and finish. Most of these are new listings with little owner history, so the Primea scores reward a clear claim and flag every case where the seller should be asked about anchors before money changes hands.

products.name: roomfitters Queen Size Wood Murphy Cabinet Bed with Rattan Storage Drawer, Free Standing
products.verdict: Freestanding by name, with real storage under the bed.
products.description:
The roomfitters Queen is a wood cabinet bed with a freestanding design stated in the listing. A large rattan drawer sits under the mattress, which gives a studio somewhere to put bedding and clothes, and a white finish suits small rooms. A queen mattress is roughly 60 inches wide, enough for two adults.

It ranks first because it pairs the freestanding claim with usable storage, which the Peanu frame does not mention. It is also the only queen here that offers both. The price sits in the $500 and up bucket.

Buy it if you rent and want a queen bed without wall mounting. The caveats are real: it is a new listing with little history, so confirm the anchor method with the seller, and the cabinet is heavy to assemble. Plan on two people and a few hours.
products.idealFor: Renters wanting a queen bed and storage without wall mounting.
products.skipIf: You want a long track record first.

products.name: roomfitters Full Size Wood Murphy Cabinet Bed with Rattan Storage Drawer, Free Standing
products.verdict: The same freestanding idea in a smaller full-size build.
products.description:
The roomfitters Full uses the same freestanding cabinet idea in a smaller build: a full mattress, roughly 54 inches wide, a rattan drawer under the bed and a green finish that stands apart from the usual white and gray. The smaller footprint matters in a studio where the bed has to fold away in a tight room.

It ranks second because the full mattress sleeps one person comfortably but a couple less so, which is the only real tradeoff against the queen. It shares the listing's new status and the $500 and up price.

Buy it for a solo sleeper or a guest room. Skip it if two adults will sleep in it every night. The caveat: as with its sibling, verify the anchor method before ordering, since a stated freestanding design does not always mean no tip-over hardware.
products.idealFor: Solo sleepers in studios or guest rooms.
products.skipIf: Two adults will sleep in it.

products.name: Peanu Queen Bed Frame, Freestanding Murphy Bed, Gray Finish, Wooden Doors
products.verdict: A queen freestanding frame with wooden doors and no wall bracket.
products.description:
The Peanu gray frame is a queen freestanding bed with wooden doors, and the listing says no wall mount bracket is required. For a renter, that line is the key spec. A gray finish and a door front make it read as furniture, which suits a living room better than a white bedroom cabinet.

It ranks third behind the roomfitters pair because no storage is listed, so you get a bed and little else. Against them, its door design may suit a shared space better.

Buy it for a clean look and a bed that disappears behind doors. The caveat: it is a new listing, so ask the seller about tip-over anchors, and plan to add your own storage elsewhere. It sits in the $500 and up bucket, the same as the roomfitters beds.
products.idealFor: Buyers who want a neat gray front and no wall mounting.

products.name: Peanu Queen Murphy Bed Cabinet, Fold Out Cabinet Bed, Built in Shelf, White
products.verdict: A queen cabinet with a shelf, but the freestanding claim is unclear.
products.description:
The second Peanu is a queen fold-out cabinet with a built-in shelf and a white finish. The shelf adds a place for a lamp, books or a phone when the bed is closed, which makes the cabinet useful as day-time furniture.

It ranks fourth because freestanding is the whole point of this roundup, and the listing does not state the claim as clearly as the others do. The Peanu gray frame above is explicit about needing no bracket, which this one is not.

Consider it if you like the shelf layout and are willing to confirm anchoring before you buy. Skip it if you need a confirmed freestanding bed. Ask the seller directly whether the cabinet stands without a wall attachment, and keep the answer in writing in case you need to return it.
products.idealFor: Buyers who like a shelf and will confirm anchoring.
products.skipIf: You need a confirmed freestanding bed.

products.award: Best Charging Station, Wall Mount Likely
products.name: LIVAUVEAD Farmhouse Queen Size Murphy Bed with Charging Station, White
products.verdict: A farmhouse queen with a charging station, likely needing wall mounting.
products.description:
The LIVAUVEAD is a queen farmhouse-style Murphy bed with a built-in charging station and a white finish. It is the cheapest bed here, in the $200 to $500 bucket, and the farmhouse styling suits a rustic bedroom.

It ranks last because the listing does not state a freestanding design, and wall mounting is likely required. That puts it outside the promise of this guide. It stays as a lower priced alternative for buyers who can mount to a wall.

Buy it if you own the home and can anchor into studs. Skip it if you rent or cannot drill. The charging station is a convenience, not a substitute for the stability a freestanding base provides. Confirm the mounting requirement with the seller before you commit.
products.idealFor: Homeowners who can anchor to a wall.

whatMatters.detail: A freestanding Murphy bed stands on its own base instead of bolting to wall studs. It matters for renters and plaster walls, where drilling is a problem. Look for the words no wall mount required or free standing in the title, then ask the seller about tip-over anchors, because a label alone does not prove it.

A full mattress is about 54 inches wide, while a queen is about 60 inches. Those six inches decide whether a couple fits comfortably. Check the listed size, and measure the room, including the open-bed depth, which is much longer than the closed cabinet. Allow for the bed's swing and for a clear path around it, plus space to make the bed.

An underbed drawer or shelf turns the cabinet into more than a bed. It matters in a small room where floor space is scarce and bedding needs a home. Look for named storage features in the listing and their size. The roomfitters beds list a rattan drawer, and the Peanu cabinet lists a shelf.

Cabinet beds are heavy and arrive in multiple boxes. You may need two people and several hours to assemble one, plus tools. Check the listed shipping weight and assembly notes before ordering, and confirm that the delivery route into your building can handle large cartons. Allow floor space to unpack parts, and keep the hardware sorted.

New listings have fewer owner reports to learn from. That is not a flaw by itself, but it raises the cost of a bad surprise on a heavy furniture item. Message the seller about anchors, mattress thickness and returns before buying. Keep their answers in writing, and check the return window before assembly.

faq.q: Is a freestanding Murphy bed safe without wall anchors?
faq.a: Some designs rely on weight and a wide base, but you should still ask the seller about tip-over anchors. Do not assume that a freestanding label means no anchoring is ever advised, especially with children in the home.

faq.q: What is the biggest mistake buyers make?
faq.a: Skipping the room measurements. Check the open-bed depth and ceiling height, not only the closed cabinet size, because an open queen bed reaches much further into the room than the closed cabinet suggests.

faq.q: Is queen worth it over full?
faq.a: For two sleepers, yes, since the queen is about six inches wider. One person in a small room can use the roomfitters Full and save floor space for walking.

Expect heavy boxes and a few hours with two people. Read the listing for tools included, and lay out the pieces before you start. A freestanding cabinet still needs a flat floor, so level it before loading the mattress.

faq.q: Do I need a special mattress?
faq.a: Many Murphy beds need a mattress of limited thickness so the cabinet can close. Check the stated maximum thickness before you choose a mattress, and ask the seller whether one is supplied or recommended.

faq.q: Why are wall-mount kits left out?
faq.a: Hardware kits require wall mounting and a cabinet you build yourself. They do not match a search for a freestanding bed, and they are not ranked here for that reason. Only complete cabinet beds appear in this guide.

finalTake: Buy the roomfitters Queen for two sleepers who want storage, or the Full for one person in a studio. The Peanu gray frame suits a living room look with no bracket. Treat the shelf cabinet as a maybe, and the LIVAUVEAD as a wall-mount bed for owners only.
